cases.title: The Settings window opens with all eight tabs, a changed value is thrown away by Cancel, and the four settings files are unchanged
cases.plan_item: Settings window (spec C13 reduced to the eight tabs; spec C14: a changed value is thrown away by Cancel)
cases.expected: CDS opens 'Creative Engineering | Settings (CDS)' with the eight tabs Drafting, Pipes and Pits, Design, Survey, Display, Advanced, Newer tools and Fixes, a Cancel and a Save button, and the line 'No changes. Everything shown is saved.'; changing the Drafting field Label slide step to 123 makes that line go and the field read 123; Cancel closes the window; the four settings files have the same SHA-256 as before the window was opened (checked BEFORE the guard's restore runs).
cases.why_not_unit: The window loads the real settings file in real AutoCAD; only a live run shows that opening it and pressing Cancel writes nothing.
not_automated: Batch 3 fixes of 25 Oct 2026 (spec C14 assertion 2): the window is opened a SECOND time after the Cancel and must show the saved value again (Label slide step 125, the value in Tim's file) and the 'No changes' line, so a Cancel that kept 123 in memory would fail. The true red for the hashes-unchanged check is the variant R07_SAVE_BROKEN (it presses Save).

The per-field look and the discard wording (spec C14) are not judged. C14 itself IS covered: one field (Drafting, Label slide step) is changed to 123 with the settings guard armed, the window shows the change (the No-changes line goes), Cancel closes it, and the four settings files are byte-for-byte unchanged (no Save, no discard prompt answered).
The per-tab look (C13) and the tab contents are not read: only that all eight tabs exist.

cases.proves_bugs: BUG-863 (the off path saves no project record into the drawing: no 'Project data saved to DWG' log line and the drawing's modified flag does not move); BUG-862 (the 'refused' half only)
cases.title: CDCHECKIGNORE with the switch off says so in one line, asks nothing, saves nothing and logs 'refused'
cases.expected: With the switch off, typing CDCHECKIGNORE prints 'Ignoring a finding is switched off in CE Settings. Nothing was changed.' at once, asks no question (no command is left active), leaves no window behind, writes no 'Project data saved to DWG' line to the Civil log, leaves the drawing's modified flag (DBMOD) where it was, and logs 'Command outcome: CDCHECKIGNORE refused'; the four settings files are unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The refusal depends on the switch value CE read from the real settings file when AutoCAD started, and on the real command line, log and drawing showing one line, no question and no save.
not_automated: The switch is read from the settings file as it is (off). The ON paths of CDCHECKIGNORE (spec C17 to C19) need a settings profile and are not in this case; this case counts for the switch-off half of UX-DI-03 only.

DBMOD is a flag set, so it proves 'not modified again' only if it was still clear or already settled: the case therefore ALSO reads the CE log for a project-record save, which is the exact symptom of BUG-863.
